About Deliveroo Our mission is to transform the way people shop and eat bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers restaurants shops and riders. We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of one of the most rapidly expanding industries in the world a complex always-on three-sided marketplace that impacts millions of people every day. Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash bringing together teams with even greater reach scale and ambition. Depending on your role you may collaborate with teammates systems and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together we re unlocking new possibilities as one global team. The Team BizOps is the team that keeps its finger on the pulse of business performance continuously rigorously and across multiple dimensions at once. We turn raw operational and financial data into actionable intelligence surfacing what is happening why it is happening and what to expect next for the operators executives and functional teams who run the business day to day. We are not a reporting function that produces outputs on request. We work continuously proactively watching delivering and questioning whether the signal is real acting as first responders to surprising deviations from expectation and using what we learn to drive faster better decision-making for the business at large. Our work spans the full stack of analytics from the warehouse models that make metrics trustworthy to the monitoring systems that catch problems early to the reports and dashboards that make performance visible to the deep-dive investigations that explain what the numbers mean and what we should do about it. We anchor our analysis to the right reference points how performance compares to plan to prior periods and to what we d expect and we bring causal rigour when the business needs to know whether an action actually worked. The culture within the team is informal fast-paced and entrepreneurial. Given the growth of the business and the level of senior stakeholder exposure progression in the team can be fast. The Role Deliveroo is hiring a Senior Data Scientist to join BizOps based in our London HQ hybrid minimum three days per week in the office . This role is largely project-based starting from a strategic or performance question you ll combine data business context and structured problem-solving to provide the insights that drive decision-making at a global level with senior stakeholders. You will own delivery end-to-end from the messy ambiguous question to a rigorous trustworthy and actionable answer. You ll be equally comfortable building the systems that make performance visible and going deep on the investigations that explain it. One week you might diagnose why a key market has moved away from plan the next identify the drivers behind a change in customer or operational performance the next build monitoring that helps teams spot and understand emerging issues earlier. Success in this role requires building effective working relationships across Deliveroo particularly with international markets as well as the Data Science Operations Commercial and Finance teams. What You ll Be Doing Answer the questions that matter continuously. Maintain a rigorous view on business performance Are we on track against our goals What s changed How does this compare with what we expected What should we expect next Then go further Why is it happening what matters most and what should we do about it Own delivery end-to-end. Independently identify define and deliver impactful work aligned with business goals operating with minimal guidance to ship fast high-quality solutions. Navigate ambiguity. Deconstruct broad ambiguous problem spaces into structured analytical roadmaps and understand how your work intersects with adjacent systems and teams. Build for scale not one-offs. Build the pipelines models dashboards monitoring and investigative tooling that make performance visible and reliable. Automate wherever possible redoing analyses by hand is slow and error-prone. Measure impact with discipline. Design measurement strategies from simple A/B tests to quasi-experimental designs synthetic control difference-in-differences event studies when trials aren t feasible always with conservative assumption-explicit language. Be a first responder. Surface deviations before they become escalations and be just as willing to give the confident this is noise no action needed as the alarm. Communicate to influence. Contribute to the broader Analytics community improve shared approaches and best practices and help build data literacy across the business.
